headline.purpose: 新会话的操作引导标题；当前没有独立品牌 display 字体。

shadows.name: work-surface
shadows.purpose: 桌面工作面与外层底色的柔和分离；手机取消。

shadows.name: inspector-drawer
shadows.purpose: 执行过程覆盖式抽屉；同时使用 #152a4a44 遮罩。

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: 按钮颜色、输入边线与 Plan 滑块状态切换。

motion.name: loading-spin
motion.purpose: 正在运行的加载图标旋转。

motion.name: thinking-breathe
motion.purpose: 思考点透明度变化；三个点分别延迟 0、.15s、.3s。

motion.name: companion-sampling
motion.purpose: bloub 引擎最多每秒采样 30 帧；隐藏页暂停，减少动态效果时显示代表帧。

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: 系统减少动态效果时取消全局 CSS 动画和过渡。

components.name: 开启新对话
components.description: 侧边栏主要操作；全宽、最小高 44px。
components.html: <button class="ds-new-chat" type="button"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg>开启新对话</button>
components.css: .ds-new-chat { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:9px; min-height:44px; width:100%; border:0; border-radius:10px; background:var(--accent,#315cda); color:#fff; font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-new-chat:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#254ab9; } .ds-new-chat:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#315cda); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-new-chat:active:not(:disabled) { filter:brightness(.96); } .ds-new-chat:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.48; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-new-chat { animation:none !important; transition:none !important; scroll-behavior:auto !important; } }

components.name: 记忆次要操作
components.description: 记忆页刷新、编辑等描边操作。
components.css: .ds-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; min-height:34px; padding:7px 11px; border:1px solid var(--line,#dce3ed); border-radius:8px; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--ink,#202c40); font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; font-size:12px; line-height:1.5; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--surface-soft,#f5f7fb); border-color:#bbc8dc; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#315cda); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { filter:brightness(.96); } .ds-secondary:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.45; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-secondary { animation:none !important; transition:none !important; scroll-behavior:auto !important; } }

components.name: 图标轻操作
components.description: 顶部栏和抽屉的轻量图标操作。
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" type="button" aria-label="关闭面板"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m18 6-12 12M6 6l12 12"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:36px; height:36px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:var(--muted,#5d6b80); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-icon-button:hover { background:var(--accent-soft,#eaf0ff); color:var(--accent,#315cda); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#315cda); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-icon-button:active:not(:disabled) { filter:brightness(.96); } .ds-icon-button:disabled { opacity:.48; cursor:not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-icon-button { animation:none !important; transition:none !important; scroll-behavior:auto !important; } }

components.name: 发送消息
components.description: 输入区内的主要图标动作；包含发送不可用状态。
components.html: <button class="ds-send" type="button" aria-label="发送消息"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m5 12 7-7 7 7M12 19V5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-send { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:36px; height:36px; border:0; border-radius:10px; background:var(--accent,#315cda); color:#fff; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-send:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#254ab9; } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#315cda); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-send:active:not(:disabled) { filter:brightness(.96); } .ds-send:disabled { background:#dfe6f2; color:#72839c; opacity:1; cursor:not-allowed; } @media (max-width:760px) { .ds-send { width:34px; height:34px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-send { animation:none !important; transition:none !important; scroll-behavior:auto !important; } }

components.name: 记忆搜索
components.description: 列表内搜索入口；输入提示使用实际 muted token。
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input class="ds-search-input" type="search" aria-label="搜索记忆" placeholder="名称、标签或正文" /></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:38px; padding:0 11px; border:1px solid var(--line,#dce3ed); border-radius:9px; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--muted,#5d6b80); } .ds-search:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#315cda); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-search-input { min-width:0; width:100%; border:0; outline:none; background:transparent; padding:9px 0; color:var(--ink,#202c40); caret-color:var(--accent,#315cda); font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; font-size:12px; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color:var(--muted,#5d6b80); } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { outline:none; } @media (max-width:760px) { .ds-search { min-height:42px; } .ds-search-input { font-size:16px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-search, .ds-search-input { animation:none !important; transition:none !important; scroll-behavior:auto !important; } }

components.name: 工作空间导航

components.css: .ds-nav { display:grid; gap:4px; padding:12px 0 18px; border-bottom:1px solid #d7e0ed; } .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; min-height:42px; padding:10px 12px; border:0; border-radius:9px; background:transparent; color:#4e607a; text-align:left; font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; font-size:13px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:#e1e9f4; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background:#dce6fa; color:#254ebd; font-weight:600; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#315cda); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-nav-item:active:not(:disabled) { filter:brightness(.96); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-nav, .ds-nav-item { animation:none !important; transition:none !important; scroll-behavior:auto !important; } }

components.name: Plan 模式开关
components.description: 已开启状态的视觉示例；实际切换由应用事件与 ViewModel 提供。
components.css: .ds-plan { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; border:0; padding:6px 8px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--surface-soft,#f5f7fb); color:var(--muted,#5d6b80); font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; font-size:11px; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-plan-track { width:26px; height:16px; padding:2px; border-radius:10px; background:#a3b0c3; } .ds-plan-thumb { display:block; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; background:#fff; transition:transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-plan[aria-checked="true"] { color:var(--accent,#315cda); background:var(--accent-soft,#eaf0ff); } .ds-plan[aria-checked="true"] .ds-plan-track { background:var(--accent,#315cda); } .ds-plan[aria-checked="true"] .ds-plan-thumb { transform:translateX(10px); } .ds-plan:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#315cda); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-plan:active:not(:disabled) { filter:brightness(.96); } .ds-plan:disabled { opacity:.48; cursor:not-allowed; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-plan, .ds-plan-thumb, .ds-plan-track { animation:none !important; transition:none !important; scroll-behavior:auto !important; } }

components.name: 子任务卡片
components.description: 进入完整子任务过程的整行按钮；文案仅为设计预览。
components.css: .ds-subagent { width:100%; display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; padding:15px 16px; border:1px solid var(--line,#dce3ed); border-radius:12px; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--accent,#315cda); text-align:left; font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-subagent:hover { background:var(--surface-soft,#f5f7fb); border-color:#b6c7e7; } .ds-subagent:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#315cda); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-subagent:active:not(:disabled) { filter:brightness(.96); } .ds-subagent-body { min-width:0; flex:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; font-size:12px; line-height:1.65; } .ds-subagent-title { color:var(--ink,#202c40); font-weight:600; } .ds-subagent-description { overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; color:var(--muted,#5d6b80); } .ds-subagent-state { flex-shrink:0; font-size:11px; color:var(--accent,#315cda); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-subagent, .ds-subagent-body, .ds-subagent-description, .ds-subagent-state, .ds-subagent-title { animation:none !important; transition:none !important; scroll-behavior:auto !important; } }

components.name: 消息输入工作面
components.description: 从单行开始的输入容器；发送按钮同排，Plan 与上下文位于下方工具行。
components.css: .ds-composer { display:flex; align-items:flex-end; gap:12px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid #c7d3e6; border-radius:16px; background:var(--surface,#fff); transition:border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color:var(--accent,#315cda); } .ds-composer-input { display:block; width:100%; flex:1; min-width:0; min-height:1.65em; margin:5px 0; overflow-y:auto; max-height:180px; border:0; outline:0; resize:none; background:transparent; padding:0 2px; color:var(--ink,#202c40); caret-color:var(--accent,#315cda); font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; font-size:15px; line-height:1.65; } .ds-composer-input::placeholder { color:var(--muted,#5d6b80); } .ds-composer-input:focus-visible { outline:0; } @media (max-width:760px) { .ds-composer { gap:10px; padding:8px 10px; } .ds-composer-input { font-size:16px; margin:4px 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-composer, .ds-composer-input { animation:none !important; transition:none !important; scroll-behavior:auto !important; } }

narrative.overview:
蓝灰色桌面托起明亮的白色工作面，黑色 bloub 伙伴提供持续可见的陪伴与任务状态。界面的个性来自清楚的区域关系、准确的状态反馈和轻盈的留白；主要内容仍是用户输入、回复与记忆正文。

操作区保持紧凑，阅读区保留宽松行距。钴蓝集中标识主要动作、当前位置、可访问的链接与正在进行的工作；轻边线和中性色阶组织信息，柔和阴影仅区分工作面与抽屉的空间层级。
keyCharacteristics: 蓝灰底、白色工作面、钴蓝动作色。
同一套中文系统字体，标题、正文与辅助信息层次分明。
黑色伙伴与文字状态共同反馈真实任务阶段；桌面伙伴固定在侧栏顶部，与 QRClaw 名称和真实状态成组，聊天与记忆保持同一位置和实例；手机延续欢迎区或顶栏伙伴。
独立滚动的工作区域，窄屏通过抽屉与列表、详情切换保留阅读空间。

rules.name: The Action Blue Rule
rules.body: 钴蓝对应动作、选择、链接或真实运行状态；大面积阅读背景使用中性色。

rules.name: The Reading Rhythm Rule
rules.body: 正文保持宽松行距，工具与元信息保持紧凑；不要用辅助标签的字号承载长回复。

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: 常规内容靠底色和细线分区；保留阴影给承载整个工作区的表面与覆盖式执行抽屉。

dos: **Do** 使用既有语义色；placeholder 与辅助文字使用 `muted`。
**Do** 保持伙伴与真实状态相邻；桌面固定在侧栏顶部，手机延续欢迎区或顶栏，并由真实活动数据驱动形态。
**Do** 维持正文行距、局部滚动与窄屏抽屉的键盘焦点行为。
**Do** 为可操作项提供悬停、聚焦、禁用及必要的错误反馈。
**Do** 保留减少动态效果与页面隐藏时暂停的行为。
donts: **Don't** 把截图中的验证示例、数量或运行状态变成产品默认内容。
**Don't** 为工作伙伴另加独占正文高度的状态带，或同时挂载多个动画实例。
**Don't** 用装饰网格、霓虹或新增背景渐变覆盖安静的阅读工作面。
**Don't** 把 sidecar 的合成色阶、未使用变量或局部色差当成已统一的全局规范。
**Don't** 把当前操作界面的系统标题字体扩展为独立品牌展示字体规范。
